title: Finite constant local models have bounded-target internal-Hom continuity
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite, and choose $A=\mathcal O_E$, $\Lambda=\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ or $A=E$, $\Lambda=\underline E$ [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. Let $T$ be any scheme and $B_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use $D(B_T)$ as in [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Let $L$ be a $B_T$-module sheaf with a finite constant local model [sk-def-sfb-constructible]: on a pro-étale cover $W_\alpha\to T$ it is $B_{W_\alpha}\otimes_{\underline A}\underline{P_\alpha}$, with $P_\alpha$ a finitely presented $A$-module. All sites and indexing categories are small in the fixed module universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Filtered colimits below are termwise sheaf colimits of functorial complex representatives, and all comparison maps are induced by the original cocone. For every small filtered diagram $(N_i^\bullet)$ of $B_T$-module complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with $H^r(N_i)=0$ for all $i$ and $r<c$, the evaluation-induced map
$$\varinjlim_i R\mathcal Hom_{B_T}(L[0],N_i)\longrightarrow R\mathcal Hom_{B_T}(L[0],\varinjlim_iN_i)$$
is an isomorphism [sk-def-sfb-derived-tensor-hom]. Moreover $R\mathcal Hom_{B_T}(L[0],N)\in D^{\ge c}(B_T)$ whenever $N\in D^{\ge c}(B_T)$, where $D^{\ge c}$ means vanishing cohomology in degrees $<c$ [def-sbc-standard-tstructure-derived-category]. No Noetherianity of $T$ or torsion-freeness of $P_\alpha$ is assumed.
